lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spot clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, transitioning into a more dispersed grid pattern as they progress posteriorly across the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance spots to form a discernible grid-like arrangement in the mid-lateral flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal aspect and lower-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral aspect.
